Question 14
?

Identify the surface x2−y2+2z2−2y−8z−9=0.

a
A hyperboloid of one sheet centered at (0,1,2)
b
A ellipsoid centered at (0,−1,2)
c
A hyperboloid of two sheets centered at (0,−1,2)
d
A hyperboloid of two sheets centered at (0,−1,−2)
e
A hyperboloid of one sheet centered at (0,−1,2)
